name: Warehouse — First Delivery
tagline: Teach your robot warehouse interactions: loading and unloading orders.
narrative:
Welcome to the Warehouse!

Your robot is driving along an automated warehouse aisle containing one waiting package and one outbound station.

While the robot already knows how to drive along the aisle, driving alone doesn't complete orders! Teach it two interaction decisions: pick up the package when standing on its tile, and deliver it when arriving at Outbound A.
objective: Pick up the waiting package and deliver it to Outbound A.
learningObjective: Use environmental facts (packageHere, deliveryHere) to trigger interaction actions alongside navigation.
intelligenceExplanation:
The starter brain includes navigation rules for moving along the aisle. Add interaction rules placed above navigation.

Rules to add: 1) WHEN packageHere -> DO pick-up, 2) WHEN deliveryHere && carryingPackage -> DO deliver. Order interaction rules above navigation so the robot interacts before moving past stations.
hint: Add WHEN packageHere -> DO pick-up and WHEN deliveryHere && carryingPackage -> DO deliver above navigation.
hints: The aisle route is pre-configured in the rules list.
Add a pickup rule: WHEN packageHere -> DO pick-up.
Add a delivery rule: WHEN deliveryHere && carryingPackage -> DO deliver, and place both above navigation.
brief: Program the robot to pick up the waiting order and drop it off at Outbound A.
context: The robot already drives down the aisle, but doesn't know how to pick up or deliver packages.
